title: Dingdong Dantes, Marian Rivera introduce story worth remembering in ‘Remember’ official poster
summary: A little winter magic, a lot of love, and a story worth keeping. ❄️️ Dingdong Dantes and Marian Rivera capture all these in the official poster of “Remember”, coming to cinemas on November 11.
